summary: Reverified s1_flexibility_chatgpt_vs_google, s1_fluency_chatgpt_vs_google, and s1_originality_chatgpt_vs_google against the paper. Read the complete markdown conversion, including references and the Supporting Information notice. PDF p. 7, Table 3, rows 2-4 confirms all 12 recorded means and SDs in the correct outcome rows and ChatGPT/Google columns. PDF p. 4, Table 1 prints 60 people in each arm; PDF p. 3, Sections 3.1-3.2 confirms these arm sizes and states that every participant completed all tasks and none were excluded, supporting the analyzed counts. PDF pp. 3-6 confirms the between-person contrast, participant-level summed task scores, immediate outcomes with assistance available, active Google comparator, and the flexibility, fluency, and rarity scoring. The question, construct, measure, unit, higher_is, outcome_with_ai, outcome_timing, within_person, comparison_type, and sd_level codes are supported. se_basis=not_reported is appropriate: no pairwise sampling uncertainty is printed for these contrasts; the arm SDs describe dispersion, Table 3 tests are three-arm omnibus tests, and Section 6.1 reports omnibus effects and within-arm changes. Figure 2 on PDF p. 8 supplies no identified ChatGPT-versus-Google pairwise statistic; no figure values were inferred. The unprinted contrast totals and pairwise statistics correctly remain null. No additional eligible outcome or contrast was found in the supplied document under extraction rules 4-6: the extraction includes all three output outcomes for both AI-versus-comparison contrasts. Coverage limitation: the separate online appendix named on PDF p. 16 is not included in the PDF or markdown, no matching local supplement was found, and the PDF has no embedded files. Wiley article and Crossref DOI API retrieval attempts using urllib and User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1 both failed with WinError 10013. Additional appendix-only results therefore remain unverified; this does not identify an error in the three checked estimates.
